en_summary: @EliteOptions2: extreme fear but no panic yet; he expects one more flush before FOMC next Wednesday; $QQQ under 700 opens 693 and 685, and $SPX to 7500 is in play if it breaks 7620.
text:
TRADE PLAN For LOTTO Friday 📈 

Alright we are in the extreme fear category BUT no real panic yet. There's still lots of pressure on Semiconductor and AI related stocks. I think we see one more flush before FOMC next Wednesday before we start to carve out a bottom. The fact that $QQQ broke under last Friday's lows is not a good sign for tech. $QQQ under 700 we can see 693,685 next. $SPX to 7500 in play if it breaks under 7620 as well. 

Tread lightly and make sure you're not going all in BEFORE FOMC. That's how you get cooked. $SMH can drop to 500 on the next leg lower, this is most likely where a short term bottom will form. $NBIS 145 is the prime buy zone if it drops there next week. $SNDK if they flush this one more time we can see 1000 before midterm elections.

It's a risk off environment until after FOMC. I've been saying this since last week. Survive a bit longer we're getting closer to a bottom. 🫡

name: The Transcript
zh_summary: $META 在 2026 年第三季自由現金流轉為負值，達負 21 億美元，資本支出（包括融資租賃本金）達 349 億美元，主要受伺服器、數據中心及網絡基礎設施投資推動，由財務長指出。（引用貼文提到 Alphabet 在 26 年第二季因資本支出亦出現負 59 億美元自由現金流。）
en_summary: $META's free cash flow turned negative in Q3 2026 at -$2.1 billion, as capital expenditures including finance leases reached $34.9 billion driven by servers, data centers and network infrastructure investments, according to the CFO. (Quoted post notes Alphabet also had negative FCF of $5.9B in Q2 26 due to CapEx.)
text:
$META's FCF turned negative in Q3 2026:

"Capital expenditures, including principal payments on finance leases, were $34.9 billion, driven by investments in servers, data centers and network infrastructure. Free cash flow was negative $2.1 billion." -  CFO
